title: PAC 339 VT2 PRO corn (PAC 339): Yield, Maturity and Characteristics
metaTitle: PAC 339 VT2 PRO corn: Yield, Maturity and Characteristics
metaDescription: PAC 339 VT2 PRO corn is a yellow GM hybrid corn variety for Luzon. About 106 days to harvest, 7.7 t/ha in trials. See its ratings and traits.
excerpt: PAC 339 VT2 PRO corn is a yellow GM hybrid corn variety, also sold or known as PAC 339 or Advanta PAC 339. It was registered with the National Seed Industry Council (NSIC) in 2019 as NSIC 2019 GMCn 61. Advanta Seeds bred it. It takes about 106 days from planting to the harvest of dry grain, with 7.7 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials.

blocks.text: If you came here looking for PAC 339 or Advanta PAC 339, this is the same corn. The facts below come from the NSIC registry kept by the Bureau of Plant Industry, with notes from its seller and farm sources. blocks.text: How long does it take, and how much does it yield?

PAC 339 VT2 PRO corn takes about 106 days from planting to the harvest of dry grain. That is about the average of the 89 yellow GM hybrid corn varieties with a day count, 105.4 days. A shorter crop frees the field sooner and dodges more of the weather, while a longer one often fills more.

Its average yield of 7.7 t/ha trails the average of its group, 8.13. One tonne of shelled corn fills about 20 sacks of 50 kilograms. Trial yields come from well managed plots, so your own will depend on water, fertilizer, pests and timing. Its seller gives about 106 in NSIC trials (GM), 103 to 107 for the conventional version.

Once you know the day count, anee.io dates every task from each lot's own planting day, with [the growth stages and weather](/features/growth-stages-and-weather) beside it.
Is it resistant to pests and diseases?

blocks.caption: Reactions in the registry trials, rated under natural field conditions

blocks.text: It showed no weak spot in the ratings on record. Still, a resistant variety can break down when a new strain or pest population comes, so keep scouting. Read up on [Asian corn borer](/pests/asian-corn-borer).

The pests and diseases that hit corn fields most often: [Asian corn borer](/pests/asian-corn-borer), [banded leaf and sheath blight](/diseases/banded-leaf-and-sheath-blight), [Corn downy mildew](/diseases/corn-downy-mildew), [Corn ear rot](/diseases/corn-ear-rot), [Corn earworm](/pests/corn-earworm). Our [pest finder](/pests) and [disease finder](/diseases) help you name what you see.

Its ears grew about 18.27 cm long in the trials. The shelling recovery was 82 percent, the share of the ear weight that comes off as grain. A higher share means more grain from every sack of ears. Against lodging it rated resistant, so it stood up well when wind and rain pushed the plants.
What its seller and farm sources say

items: **Yield:** Second highest yield at the Camarines Norte provincial derby, third in net income at the 2022 Pampanga derby, NSIC trials averaged 7.7 t/ha in Luzon (GM), conventional 7.41 Luzon, 6.70 Visayas.

**Traits in the seed:** VT Double PRO (events MON89034 x NK603): two built in insect protection genes against Asian corn borer, earworm and armyworms, plus glyphosate (Roundup) tolerance, 95:5 refuge seed blend.
High shelling (about 80 to 82 percent) in NSIC trials.
Registry rates it resistant to lodging and corn borer.

blocks.text: Why farmers know it: best shelling recovery at DA Bicol's Camarines Norte and Camarines Sur derbies, second in yield at Camarines Norte, third in net income at Central Luzon's 2022 Pampanga derby. Check these against what farmers near you have seen, because the same variety can do differently from one town to the next.
Where and when to plant PAC 339 VT2 PRO corn

The registry recommends it for Luzon. Start with the color your buyer pays for: yellow corn goes to feed mills, while white and glutinous corn go to the table. Next, pick between a hybrid, which yields more but needs new seed every season, and an open pollinated variety, whose seed you can save. Then match the island group in its recommendation, because trials in Luzon and Mindanao give different winners. Before planting, get the field ready with our guide: [Land preparation for corn](/land-preparation/corn-land-preparation).

items.q: Is PAC 339 the same as PAC 339 VT2 PRO?
items.a: Yes. PAC 339 is another name for PAC 339 VT2 PRO, registered as NSIC 2019 GMCn 61. Seed sellers use both, so ask for either one.

items.q: How long does it take to harvest?
items.a: It takes about 106 days from planting to the harvest of dry grain. Then the weather and your care decide the exact day.
The record shows 7.7 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials. Your own yield depends on the soil, water, fertilizer and pests on your farm.
No. It is a hybrid, so seed saved from it does not grow true and yields less. Buy new seed each season.
The registry recommends it for Luzon. Ask your municipal agriculturist how it has done in your town.

items.q: Where can I buy seed of PAC 339 VT2 PRO?
items.a: Ask an accredited seed dealer in your province, the seller named on this page or your municipal agriculturist. Look for the certified seed tag or a sealed pack before you pay.
